She has her hands on her hips and an angry, stern facial expression. Behind her is a dark wooden bookshelf filled with books and various decorative objects. (3) A man in a green hoodie appears in the background, looking through his hands like binoculars. The woman is seated at a table, looking down at a laptop screen. They are in a room with green and white walls. (4) A man in a black hoodie hands a large white plastic shipping package over a green metal fence outdoors. A white van is partially visible in the background. (5) Back in the hallway, a hand enters the frame holding the white package. The woman's expression transforms into wide-eyed surprise and delight as she takes the gift. (6) The woman frantically tears open the package, revealing a brown cardboard box inside. She pulls out a floral-printed fabric, her mouth agape in excitement. She begins to jump and wave her hands. (7) The woman holds up the floral dress, which has a vintage pattern. She twirls it around, her face beaming with joy. The setting is the same indoor room with wooden floors and bookshelves. (8) The woman is now wearing the new floral dress. She poses, twirls, and claps her hands to her face in extreme happiness. She looks directly at the camera with a wide smile.
